scientific_question: Does the causal enrichment of the 32-stage Muon-selected hidden Givens chart generalize across all five representative c_proj layers and all four training phases without a weak or sign-flipped cell?
causal_protocol: Current exact coherent Muon state selects hidden-channel perfect matchings and fits angles to the current scheduled update only. The future phase chord is inaccessible until scoring. Equal-size deterministic random matchings remain the control.

decision_rule.pass: promote to a compact refresh/serialization design and an exact production MFU implementation; language-model training remains blocked until that exact implementation passes at least 20 percent MFU
decision_rule.fail: reject dynamic Muon-selected Givens as non-generalizing and do not implement training

execution_policy: Run directly in the foreground on one idle Y400 GPU and poll to exit. Do not use a watchdog, callback, queue worker, heartbeat, or PRO6.
